title: Callable and Redeemable Preferred Stock
learning_objectives: Classify preferred stock as equity vs liability

callable_preferred.definition: Issuer has right to redeem (call) shares at specified price after specified date
callable_preferred.accounting_upon_call: DR Preferred Stock (par), DR APIC-Preferred, DR Retained Earnings (call premium), CR Cash

redeemable_preferred.definition: Holder has right to require issuer to redeem shares (put option)
redeemable_preferred.classification: Depends on redemption terms: (1) Mandatory = Liability, (2) Holder's option = Temporary equity (mezzanine), (3) Issuer's option = Equity
redeemable_preferred.sec_guidance: Redeemable at holder's option or on fixed date: Report outside of permanent equity (mezzanine equity)

mandatorily_redeemable.definition: Issuer MUST redeem on specified date or upon event certain to occur
mandatorily_redeemable.asc_480: Classified as liability, measured at settlement amount
mandatorily_redeemable.example: Preferred stock mandatorily redeemable in 5 years for $1M. Classify as liability, accrete to $1M over 5 years.

mezzanine_equity.definition: Equity that is not permanent (redeemable at holder's option). Presented between liabilities and equity on balance sheet.
mezzanine_equity.presentation: Separate section between total liabilities and shareholders' equity
mezzanine_equity.accretion: Increase carrying amount to redemption value over time (if redemption date certain or probable). Debit retained earnings, credit mezzanine equity.

redemption_accounting.above_par: DR Preferred Stock (par), DR APIC-Preferred (if any), DR Retained Earnings (excess), CR Cash
redemption_accounting.below_par: DR Preferred Stock (par), CR APIC-Preferred (or APIC), CR Cash
redemption_accounting.no_gain_or_loss: Redemption is equity transaction (no gain/loss in income statement)

calculation_example_callable.facts: Callable preferred stock: 10,000 shares, $10 par, $12 call price. APIC-Preferred $15K. Call all shares.
calculation_example_callable.entry: DR Preferred Stock $100K (10,000 × $10), DR APIC-Preferred $15K, DR Retained Earnings $5K, CR Cash $120K (10,000 × $12)
calculation_example_callable.note: Excess $5K over book value reduces RE (no gain/loss)

calculation_example_mandatorily_redeemab.facts: Issue mandatorily redeemable preferred for $1M cash. Redeemable in 5 years for $1.2M. Use straight-line accretion.
calculation_example_mandatorily_redeemab.issuance: DR Cash $1M, CR Mandatorily Redeemable Preferred (liability) $1M
calculation_example_mandatorily_redeemab.annual_accretion: ($1.2M - $1M) / 5 = $40K. DR Interest Expense (or Retained Earnings) $40K, CR Mandatorily Redeemable Preferred $40K
calculation_example_mandatorily_redeemab.at_maturity: DR Mandatorily Redeemable Preferred $1.2M, CR Cash $1.2M

participating_preferred.definition: Preferred stock that participates in dividends beyond stated rate (if common receives more)
participating_preferred.accounting: Affects dividend allocation. Not specifically related to callability/redeemability.
participating_preferred.cumulative_preferred: Dividends in arrears must be paid before common receives dividends

content.preferred_dividends_impact_eps: Cumulative preferred dividends (whether declared or not) reduce income available to common shareholders in basic EPS calculation
cpa_exam_tips: Callable (issuer's option): Equity. Redemption reduces equity (no gain/loss).
Redeemable at holder's option: Mezzanine equity (between liabilities and equity)
Mandatorily redeemable: LIABILITY. Accrete to redemption value.
Redemption above book value: Reduce RE for excess (no gain/loss in IS)
Mezzanine equity: Not included in total shareholders' equity
Accrete mezzanine equity to redemption value over time (debit RE)

classification_decision: Mandatory redemption or certain event → LIABILITY
Holder's option to redeem → MEZZANINE EQUITY (temporary equity)
Issuer's option to call → EQUITY (permanent equity)
cpa_exam_strategies.redemption_entry: DR Preferred Stock (par) + APIC-Preferred + RE (excess), CR Cash. No gain/loss.
cpa_exam_strategies.accretion_approach: If mandatorily redeemable or mezzanine equity with known redemption date: Accrete carrying amount to redemption value. DR Interest Expense (if liability) or RE (if mezzanine), CR Preferred Stock/Liability.
common_mistakes: Classifying mandatorily redeemable as equity (should be liability)
Including mezzanine equity in total shareholders' equity (should exclude)
Recognizing gain/loss on redemption (equity transaction - no gain/loss)
Forgetting to accrete to redemption value for mandatorily redeemable

key_points: Callable (issuer's option): Equity. Redeemable (holder's option): Mezzanine. Mandatorily redeemable: Liability.
Redemption: DR Preferred/APIC/RE, CR Cash. No gain/loss (equity transaction).
Mandatorily redeemable: Accrete to redemption value over time (classify as liability)
Mezzanine equity: Between liabilities and equity on balance sheet, not included in total equity
Excess payment over book value reduces RE (not gain/loss in IS)
